summary: No malicious behavior observed in csec-crypto-toolkit@0.0.0-stage
details: Package csec-crypto-toolkit version 0.0.0-stage ships two files and no detectable installer-harm behavior. No lifecycle scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) that fetch or execute remote content were observed, no credential or environment-variable harvesting was observed, no network beacons to attacker-controlled destinations were observed, and no dropper, backdoor, or self-propagation mechanisms were observed. The version suffix `0.0.0-stage` is consistent with a placeholder/staging publish rather than a functional release.
